title: A toy in a cylindrical box
body: A craftsperson makes a solid wooden toy in the form of a hemisphere surmounted by a right circular cone. The base of the cone sits exactly on the flat face of the hemisphere. The radius of the hemisphere and of the cone's base is 3 cm, and the height of the cone is 3 cm. To pack the toy, she uses a right circular cylinder that just circumscribes it: the cylinder's base has the same radius as the toy, and its height equals the total height of the toy from the bottom of the hemisphere to the tip of the cone. The empty space inside the cylinder is filled with packing material.
